breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It explicitly defines two segments (Segment 1: x=0 to x=750 mm, and Segment 2: x=750 mm to x=1500 mm), computes separate internal torques for each (T_segment1 = +150000 N·mm and T_segment2 = +300000 N·mm), and applies the method of sections from the free end. This directly contradicts and corrects the incomplete prompt's erroneous instruction to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length,' aligning with the ground truth's piecewise approach.
